title: Gus and the Nut
lines: Gus is a pup. He digs in the mud.
He digs up a big nut.
A bug is on the nut!
The bug hums and runs at Gus.
The bug tugs the nut to a log.
Gus digs up ten nuts in the sun.
The bug can have a nut. Gus has ten!

questions.ask: What does Gus dig up in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A big nut. It is stated in the story, so if they guess, send them back to find the line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Gus run to his hut?
questions.listenFor: The bug hummed and ran at him. You are listening for cause and effect - if they just say "the bug," ask "and what did the bug do?"

questions.ask: Do you think Gus minds that the bug got a nut? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. What you want is a reason tied to the story - "no, he dug up ten more" or "yes, he found that one first."
